title: What Scripture Actually Says About Gratitude (It's Not a Feeling)
caption:
Most guys think gratitude is a feeling that shows up on Thanksgiving if the food's good and nobody fights.

Scripture says something harder and better. Give thanks. In all circumstances. It's an act before it's an emotion.

1. Thanks is a command, not a mood.
2. It needs an address. Aim it at God.
3. It kills entitlement.
4. Say it out loud to the people at your table.

The feeling comes. But it follows the man who obeys first.

"Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you." 1 Thessalonians 5:18

Save this for tomorrow. Thank one person by name.
